description: Source file implementing multidomain logging link functions for Zephyr OS, including error handling, message processing, domain/source management, and link activation.

methods.name: log_multidomain_link_on_error
methods.description: Handles error events for the multidomain link, updating status.

methods.name: log_multidomain_link_on_started
methods.description: Handles start event, setting link as ready if no error.

methods.name: log_multidomain_link_on_recv_cb
methods.description: Callback for receiving messages, processes different message types and updates link state.

methods.name: getter_msg_process
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for a response, returning status.

methods.name: link_remote_get_domain_count
methods.description: Retrieves the number of domains from the remote link.

methods.name: link_remote_get_source_count
methods.description: Retrieves the number of sources for a given domain.

methods.name: link_remote_ready
methods.description: Checks if the link is ready.

methods.name: link_remote_activate
methods.description: Activates the link, fetching domain and source counts, and setting up control blocks.

methods.name: link_remote_get_domain_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a domain.

methods.name: link_remote_get_source_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a source within a domain.

methods.name: link_remote_get_levels
methods.description: Gets logging levels for a source.

methods.name: link_remote_set_runtime_level
methods.description: Sets the runtime logging level for a source.
